summary: New sense 1b: erstaunlich, wunderbar (attributiv, vom Gegenstand des Staunens)

data.label: 1b
data.gloss: erstaunlich, wunderbar (attributiv, vom Gegenstand des Staunens)

rationale: In 100/5 mdamro modifies ṭawfono, the marvel rather than an astonished experiencer. One clear attributive context supports a narrow adjectival subsense, not a new finite argument pattern.

data.turoyo: I aṯto mdamro w kəmmole: "Qay kogəḥxat? Əllah gdəmmatli, qay yo!"
data.translation: Die Frau war verdutzt und sprach zu ihm: "Warum lachst du? Du mußt mir unbedingt sagen, warum!"

rationale: Thin Detransitive Preterit: feminine experiencer and ensuing question favour a finite reaction, provisionally; competing adjective analysis is retained as an editor question.

summary: example for sense 1b in Part. Pass. (100/5)

data.turoyo: Pak lu ṭawfono mdamro yaquro rabano!
data.translation: Oho! Was ist dasfür ein großes, gewaltiges Wunder!

rationale: New narrow adjectival subsense 1b in Part. Pass.; one attestation, with edition translation left unexpanded.

summary: The active Preterit at 30/155 codes astonished experiencers with -L morphology; Detransitive mdamər/mdamri also describes an experiencer reaction. No expressed external agent is required; m- marks a stimulus or triggering clause.

59/90 is provisionally feminine Detransitive Preterit mdamr-o; the same written mdamro can be a masculine Part. Pass. at 66/16. Morphology and syntactic context matter more than the translation war verdutzt.
100/5 supports a stimulus-oriented attributive adjective. The German exclamation does not translate each adjective separately; it has been copied without adding an invented equivalent.
Lookup mdamro confirms the inherited dmr participial form. The separate dwmr entry uses mdawmər/mdawmro and does not justify moving dmr examples.
JL 18.7.9, 11/182, 30/155 and 66/16 are already quoted; no duplicates.
Confirm feminine finite mdamro at 59/90 against a default-gender or invariant adjective; the example is explicitly provisional.
Is stimulus-oriented mdamro at 100/5 a lexicalized adjective or a productive participial use? The proposed 1b is restricted to the attested attributive context.
What conditions the choice between active -L Preterit and Detransitive forms for astonished experiencers? These six occurrences do not establish a distribution rule.
